$comment: Every rename and removal in Tessera, grouped by the release it ships in, oldest first. An upgrade replays each release between the old and the new version, in order; inside a release every key maps straight to its final name, so one pass is enough. Unreleased entries sit in the release named next, which the release step renames to the new version. Inside a map, replace longer keys first. components holds every renamed export, components and their types. props keys are Component.prop under the old component name. A value with words after the name, or any removedExports value, is a note for a person, not a name to write. A cssClasses value may hold several classes separated by spaces; write them all.

components.PositionInput: DynamicInput with a pattern such as "X {x:number 0..63}  Y {y:number 0..63}" (see MIGRATION.md)

cssClasses.slider__mute--muted: volume-control (the mute IconButton is active and danger)
cssClasses.slider__mute: volume-control (the mute button is an IconButton)
cssClasses.search-results__count: search-results__summary (the summary text in the fixed head)
cssClasses.section-nav__search-clear: removed; the SearchInput in the nav draws the clear button (see MIGRATION.md section 49)
cssClasses.side-nav__group-title--active: removed; a SideNav group label is not a target (see MIGRATION.md section 47)
cssClasses.side-nav__group-title--action: removed; a SideNav group label is not a target (see MIGRATION.md section 47)
cssClasses.command-palette__input-icon: removed; the search icon sits inside the SearchInput of the palette (see MIGRATION.md section 49)
cssClasses.side-nav__header: settings-shell__header (SideNav takes no header; see MIGRATION.md section 47)

props.Box.href: Link.href for a URL, RouterLink.to for a route (see MIGRATION.md)
props.WidgetManager.vanillaSafe: WidgetManager.resolveDisabled (one callback with settings; see MIGRATION.md section 4)
props.WidgetManager.settings: WidgetManager.resolveDisabled (one callback with vanillaSafe; see MIGRATION.md section 4)
props.WidgetManager.onUpdate: WidgetManager.onLayoutChange(next), which takes the whole layout (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
props.WidgetManager.bounds: removed; the widgets tile around WidgetManager.main (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
props.WidgetManager.topOffset: removed; the widgets tile around WidgetManager.main (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
props.WidgetManager.onInsetsChange: removed; the main view takes the room the docked widgets leave (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
props.Widget.state: removed; Widget takes id, tabs, activeId and paneKey (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
props.Widget.onChange: removed; layout changes go through WidgetManager.onLayoutChange (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
props.Widget.dockedStyle: removed; DockLayout places the panes (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
props.WidgetLayout.widgets: the v2 layout: dock, floating, popped and frame; migrateLayout turns a stored flat layout into it (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
props.SideNav.groups: SideNav.config.groups, where each group needs an id, its title becomes label and every item needs an icon. SideNav, SideNavProps, SideNavGroup and SideNavItem keep their names but now describe the former SectionNav, so they are not mapped (see MIGRATION.md section 47)
props.SideNav.searchable: SideNav.search, which the host owns; SettingsShell.filterable keeps a filter the shell owns (see MIGRATION.md section 47)
props.SideNav.header: removed; SettingsShell.header puts a row above the nav and the panel (see MIGRATION.md section 47)
props.SideNavGroup.title: SideNavGroup.label (see MIGRATION.md section 47)
props.SideNavGroup.id: now required on every group; a group heading is no longer a target of its own (see MIGRATION.md section 47)
props.SettingsShell.nav: takes the new SideNavProps: config, activeId, onSelect and search; searchable, searchPlaceholder and header move to SettingsShell.filterable, SettingsShell.filterPlaceholder and SettingsShell.header (see MIGRATION.md section 47)

removedExports.WIDGET_DEFINITIONS: moves to the app; pass it to WidgetManager and the layout helpers as `definitions`
removedExports.DISABLED_SETTING_MESSAGES: moves to the app; DisabledOverlay takes `message`
removedExports.resolveWidgetDisabledState: moves to the app; WidgetManager takes `resolveDisabled`
removedExports.StatusBadge: merged into Status; pass tone, variant="pill" and the label as children
removedExports.ScreenStatus: removed with StatusBadge; the app maps its own statuses to a Status tone and label
removedExports.WizardDialogShell: replaced by WizardFrame with presentation="dialog" and useWizard; see MIGRATION.md
removedExports.RangeSliderProps: replaced by SliderProps with range: true
removedExports.PositionAxis: replaced by the range, step and label args of a number slot in the pattern
removedExports.PositionValue: replaced by PatternValue, an object keyed by slot name
removedExports.clampAxis: removed; DynamicInput clamps a number slot to its range when the slot is left
removedExports.clampPosition: removed; DynamicInput clamps each slot to its range when the slot is left
removedExports.isValidForAxis: removed; DynamicInput emits only values inside the range
removedExports.isWithinAxis: removed; DynamicInput emits only values inside the range
removedExports.WizardStep: the type is now WizardStepDef; WizardStep is now the component for one step
removedExports.WidgetState: removed; a widget lives in the v2 layout tree, migrateLayout converts a stored one (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.computeDockedStyles: removed; DockLayout places docked widgets (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.createDefaultWidgetState: removed; openWidget adds a widget to the layout (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.startingLayout: removed; createDefaultLayout() returns the main view alone (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.updateWidget: removed; use the pure layout edits such as dockWidget, floatWidget and setFrame (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.getWidgetState: removed; read the v2 layout (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.useWidgetDrag: removed; DockLayout handles dragging (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.useWidgetResize: removed; DockLayout handles resizing (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.getDockedResizeEdge: removed; DockLayout handles resizing (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.ExclusiveInsets: removed; the main view takes the room the docked widgets leave (see MIGRATION.md section 21)
removedExports.WidgetSettings: replaced by WidgetOptions, anchored to the gear through anchorRef (see MIGRATION.md section 21)

components.SearchSpark: Icon, drawn as <Icon name="search" effect="twinkle" className="search-glass" /> (see MIGRATION.md section 56)

cssClasses.settings-shell__content: removed with SettingsShell; the page sits in the NavLayout pane (see MIGRATION.md section 52)
cssClasses.settings-shell__header: removed with SettingsShell; the title moves to WorkspaceScreen (see MIGRATION.md section 52)
cssClasses.settings-shell: removed with SettingsShell; use nav-layout (see MIGRATION.md section 52)
cssClasses.search-spark__star: removed; the star is the twinkle of the Icon effect prop (see MIGRATION.md section 56)

props.SideNav.searchable: SideNav.search, which the host owns; NavLayout.filterable keeps a filter the layout owns (see MIGRATION.md sections 47 and 52)
props.SideNav.searchPlaceholder: SideNav.search.placeholder, or NavLayout.filterPlaceholder (see MIGRATION.md sections 47 and 52)
props.SideNav.header: removed; WorkspaceScreen.title, or a heading the host places above a NavLayout (see MIGRATION.md section 52)
props.SettingsShell.nav: removed with SettingsShell; WorkspaceScreen.nav and NavLayout.nav take SideNavProps: config, activeId, onSelect and search (see MIGRATION.md sections 47 and 52)
props.SettingsShell.header: removed; WorkspaceScreen.title, or a heading the host places above a NavLayout (see MIGRATION.md section 52)

removedExports.SettingsShell: replaced by WorkspaceScreen for a settings screen, or NavLayout with filterable inside a page; see MIGRATION.md section 52
removedExports.SettingsShellProps: replaced by WorkspaceScreenProps, or NavLayoutProps with filterable and filterPlaceholder
removedExports.SEARCH_ICON_PATHS: removed; draw the glass with <Icon name="search" /> (see MIGRATION.md section 56)
